scope.summary: Destination project and Lens/Atelier/CKC intake expose batch progress, per-item result, idempotency, retry, cancellation, and lineage.
acceptance_criteria: Fresh project-intake-contract evidence proves the complete requirement: Destination project and Lens/Atelier/CKC intake expose batch progress, per-item result, idempotency, retry, cancellation, and lineage.

[positive] Execute every named supported behavior and prove from canonical state: Destination project and Lens/Atelier/CKC intake expose batch progress, per-item result, idempotency, retry, cancellation, and lineage.

[negative] Malformed, unsupported, stale, unauthorized, or boundary-crossing variants cannot produce false success for: Destination project and Lens/Atelier/CKC intake expose batch progress, per-item result, idempotency, retry, cancellation, and lineage.

[failure_recovery] Interrupt and restart at each durable boundary; completed truth is preserved and the requirement converges without duplication: Destination project and Lens/Atelier/CKC intake expose batch progress, per-item result, idempotency, retry, cancellation, and lineage.

[concurrency] Parallel actors/jobs retain isolated identity, bounded execution, deterministic conflict handling, and attributable receipts while satisfying: Destination project and Lens/Atelier/CKC intake expose batch progress, per-item result, idempotency, retry, cancellation, and lineage.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
Legacy Stage code (WP-12) must not silently constrain this MT (STAGE-DEC-017).
Do not duplicate ArtifactStore, WP-1 ToolGate/process/promotion, or Loom authority.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

planning_metadata.implementation_note: Planning-stage MT. Exact owned_files, code anchors, and proof_commands are bound at the L00 integration baseline. Deep spec detail lives in corpus_refs; acceptance_criteria carry the provable closure unit and the positive/negative/failure_recovery/concurrency case groups.
